articles.title: Receção de uma amostra de projeto
articles.summary: Siga Identificação e campo, Condição, Análises e Entrega com uma amostra de projeto.
articles.quick: Faça corresponder a etiqueta ao registo de amostra esperado, anote a massa e anomalias de condição, confirme as análises e conclua a receção.
before: Have the physical material, label, delivery information and required intake measurements available.
Confirm your laboratory and project scope. Use the existing project record when one already represents the sample.
The exact final receipt control and any manager intake review depend on the deployed workflow; the writer must bind and verify those controls before publication.

steps.action: Open Reception and select the project. In ID & Field, find or scan the identifier on the physical label.
steps.expected: A matching source record is displayed. A KoBo submission is field provenance, not proof that the material arrived.

steps.action: Compare project, field identifier and displayed laboratory identifier. Check the source location and sampling information.
steps.expected: The correct project record is linked. If source coordinates exist but the draft is blank, preserve the discrepancy instead of inventing coordinates.

steps.action: Open Condition. Enter the actual received mass in the stated unit, the observed condition and the required compliance answers.
steps.expected: Missing values, insufficient mass or nonconformance are visible as specific issues rather than silently accepted defaults.

steps.action: Document any required exception reason. In Analyses, review the parameter names and method choices against the request.
steps.expected: The ordered work matches the request. Grouped analyses such as texture are handled according to the configured panel, not invented as unrelated tasks.

steps.action: Open Handover and review identity, condition, ordered analyses and outstanding issues. Use Save draft if the entry is not ready.
steps.expected: A saved draft remains distinct from an accepted receipt; it should not move unreceived material into drying workload.

steps.action: When complete, perform the verified final receipt action and inspect its confirmation and resulting intake state.
steps.expected: The application identifies what was received and whether another intake-review action remains. Final control binding is a required publication check for this exemplar.

steps.action: Check the sample label and the destination or handover details before transferring the physical material.
steps.expected: The next worker can identify the material and locate the corresponding tasks without duplicating intake.

fields: Match the source project record and physical label.
Actual measured mass, using the displayed grams field.
Use the intake measurement, not a default
Damaged container documented as an exception

steps.expected: The application does not silently overwrite another person's work or an approved result.
